releases.body: Fix sleep inhibition for OpenCode services started from SSH or other non-graphical sessions.
OpenCode V2 release. Prevent suspend and optional idle while agents work, including subagents, tool approvals and questions. Supports configurable cooldown and hot-reload recovery.

## What's Changed
* Add configurable post-idle cooldown by @seaweeduk in https://github.com/seaweeduk/opencode-sleep-inhibit/pull/2
